sloka: अथ रेणु समुध्वस्तम् तम् उत्थाप्य नर अधिपम् ।न्यवर्तत तदा देवी कौसल्या शोक कर्शिता ॥२-४२-१०॥
transliteration: atha reṇu samudhvastam tam utthāpya nara adhipam ।nyavartata tadā devī kausalyā śoka karśitā ॥2-42-10॥

translations.english: Then Kausalya, emaciated due to sorrow, lifted the king who was thoroughly coated with dust and returned to the palace.
